children: PetroChina Urumqi Petrochemical Co is taking its 1 million metric tons per year paraxylene (PX) plant located at Urumqi, Xinjiang offline early next week for routine two-week maintenance, industry sources said.
Located on the same site, the company is constructing a new 2 million mt/year downstream purified terephthalic acid (PTA) plant with an estimated completion date in 2027, industry sources added.

PetroChina Urumqi Petrochemical's PX plant shutdown is unlikely to significantly tighten Chinese PX supply as only about 41,667 mt capacity will be offline in October. Additionally, several other Chinese PX plants have resumed operations following annual maintenance, pushing average domestic operating rates higher by 7.4 percentage points week on week to 82.1% on Sept. 3, an industry source said.

Chinese PX inventory levels have also risen, reaching 1.6 million mt on Sept. 3, up 2.4% week on week, the source added. Consequently, overall PX supply is expected to remain fairly balanced throughout the month, though stronger demand from downstream PTA producers--driven by the upcoming winter peak in the polyester and textile sectors--could trigger a mild supply squeeze.

Reflecting that downstream demand and rising upstream energy costs, the month-to-date average CFR China PX price rose 7% month on month to $1,160.22/mt through Sept. 3, according to OPIS data. Front-month ICE Brent crude oil averaged $95.27/bbl over the first three days of September, up 17.8% from the same period in August.

As a result, import demand cooled slightly. Only two deals were recorded on the open trading platform during the first three days of September, down from three during the same period last month, industry sources said.

Bullish sentiment and rising domestic futures prices are expected to spill over into the physical market, supporting spot PX prices. The widely traded November PX futures contracts on the Zhengzhou Commodity Exchange (ZCE) ended the afternoon trading session at 8,697 yuan ($1,294.30) per lot on Sept. 3, up 7.3% week on week. Following a similar trend, the ZCE January 2027 PTA futures contract closed at 5,942 yuan/lot, up 5.5% week on week.
